---
name: Skill or installation problem
about: Report unexpected skill behavior or a broken installation
---

## Skill and agent

Skill name, agent, and relevant versions or repository revision.

## What you asked it to do

A minimal prompt and enough context to reproduce the problem. Remove credentials and private project data.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead? Include relevant errors or a short transcript.

## Installation

Installation command, operating system, and whether this is a project or global installation.
